per_candidate.id: s2:The First FRB-associated X-Ray Bursting Episode of SGR 1935+2154: Swift-BAT Obse

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the relationship between the brightness of FRBs and their spatial distribution in relation to the Cosmological Principle, nor do they address the influence of extremely bright FRBs in the Local Supercluster on our understanding of their origins and mechanisms.
